sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 376,
323, 324, 341, 504, 506/34 of Indian Penal Code.
3. Petitioner is alleged to have attempted to commit rape with the victim on the point of pistol.

4. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that victim in her statement, recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., has denied the prosecution case and has categorically stated that she was in love with this petitioner and they have solemnized marriage on 04.06.2024 and are living together as husband and wife.
Learned court below has assessed her age as Patna High Court CR.
5. Learned A.P.P. for the State vehemently opposed the bail application.

6.
